{{nihongo|'''Takahiro Shiota'''|塩田 隆比呂|Shiota Takahiro}} is a Japanese [[mathematician]] at [[Kyoto University]]. In 1986, he proved [[Sergei Novikov (mathematician)|Novikov's]] conjecture about the [[Schottky problem|Riemann–Schottky problem]] by characterization of [[Jacobian varieties]].<ref>{{cite journal |last=Shiota |first=Takahiro |year=1986 |title=Characterization of Jacobian varieties in terms of soliton equations |journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] |volume=83 |issue=2 |pages=333–382 |doi=10.1007/BF01388967 |bibcode=1986InMat..83..333S |s2cid=120739493 }}</ref>

Shiota obtained his doctorate at [[Harvard University]] in 1984.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.math.harvard.edu/dissertations/index.html |title=Harvard Mathematics Department Dissertations |access-date=2011-07-31 |archive-date=2019-04-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190404132750/http://www.math.harvard.edu/dissertations/index.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>
